description:
Development Environment, Tooling Platform and Application Framework.

Apache NetBeans is much more than a text editor. It highlights source code syntactically and semantically, lets you easily refactor code, with a range of handy and powerful tools.

Apache NetBeans 32 installers / packages provided by Friends of Apache NetBeans.
These packages are built with NBPackage using the official Apache NetBeans binary zip release and the Azul Zulu build of OpenJDK 27 (27.0.1.1). The packages themselves are not released by the Apache Software Foundation.
Artefacts in this release
- apache-netbeans-32-0.x86_64.rpm — Linux (RPM-based, e.g. Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL) x86_64 installer package
- apache-netbeans_32-1_amd64.deb — Linux (Debian-based, e.g. Debian, Ubuntu) x86_64/amd64 installer package, verified by @sevarac, @johanvos and @eirikbakke
- apache-netbeans_32-1_arm64.deb — Linux (Debian-based, e.g. Debian, Ubuntu) arm64/aarch64 installer package
- Apache-NetBeans-32-arm64.pkg — macOS (Apple Silicon) arm64 installer package, notarized by Apple, verified by @jtulach, @eirikbakke, @jperedadnr, and @geertjanw
- Apache-NetBeans-32-x86_64.pkg — macOS (Intel) x86_64 installer package, notarized by Apple, verified by @jtulach, @juneau001 and @geertjanw
- Apache-NetBeans-32.exe — Windows x86_64 installer, code-signed via SignPath, verified by @sevarac, @johanvos, and @eirikbakke
- effective.properties — Build metadata: the exact NetBeans/JDK versions, download URLs and checksums resolved for this build. Not needed to run NetBeans.
Why Azul Zulu and not Eclipse Temurin (or another distro)
Earlier Apache NetBeans releases bundled Eclipse Temurin. Starting with OpenJDK 27, Adoptium (Temurin) stopped publishing a macOS x86_64 (Intel) JDK build — only aarch64 (Apple Silicon) is available. To keep a single, consistent JDK 27 build across every installer in this release, including the Intel macOS .pkg, we switched to Azul Zulu, which continues to publish macOS x86_64 builds of OpenJDK 27.
Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938)
On 2026-11-17, OpenJDK disclosed CVE-2026-114938 ("Java4Shell"), a CVSS 8.1 pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the x86-64 HotSpot JVM's Base64 decoder, fixed in OpenJDK 27.0.1.1 (and the equivalent 17/21/25 point releases). This was taken into account when choosing the bundled runtime: all installers in this release use Zulu build 27.30.201, based on upstream OpenJDK tag jdk-27.0.1.1+4, which already includes the Java4Shell fix. No installer in this release bundles a JDK older than 27.0.1.1.
For more information about Apache NetBeans releases, please visit https://netbeans.apache.org
